equipment_type: Centrifugal chiller retrofit control panel (via SC-EQ card)
applies_to: Other makers' centrifugal chillers retrofitted with a YORK by Johnson Controls OptiView-style control panel and the SC-EQ communication card.
summary: This is the SC-EQ points list for chillers converted to Johnson Controls retrofit controls. The SC-EQ card serves BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU / N2). The BAS can start/stop the chiller, write the leaving chilled liquid setpoint and current limit, and select VSD fixed speed. Read-only points cover water temperatures, pressures, starter and VSD values, adaptive capacity control (surge) data, motor winding and bearing temperatures, and operation, safety, cycling, warning and inhibit codes as MV objects with AV copies.
notes: Access is inferred: the sheet has no read/write column. The remote block (AV 1-2, BV 1, BV 3) is treated as commandable; everything else as read-only.

Some instances depend on the starter: AV 13-15 carry VSD currents on VSD units and solid-state starter currents on SSS units; AV 35 and AV 36 carry VSD values on VSD units and solid-state or electro-mechanical starter values otherwise. AV 7 and AV 8 are printed twice, in PSIG and PSIA. These are merged into one row each.
VSD-only points (AV 32-43, AV 110-115, BV 17-21) only report on chillers with a variable speed drive.

Status-code MVs (MV 1-4, MV 6-8) are the printed code + 1, as the doc's status code tables say; the AV copies (AV 401-408) carry the raw code. MV 5 is shown as printed, from 0; the card may report the printed number + 1. Confirm by discovery.
This list has no MV 65001 Units object. Units shown are the IP units.
Spare objects and empty rows are left out.

source.title: Competitive Retrofits SC-EQ BAS Points List

integration.summary: Wire the BAS to the SC-EQ RS-485 port and set the MAC address; the card detects BACnet MS/TP. Start/stop the chiller with BV 1 and write the leaving chilled liquid setpoint (AV 1) and current limit (AV 2). Read MV 1, BV 5, the leaving water temperature and % FLA, and MV 2/MV 3 for shutdowns. MV 5 shows whether the panel is under ISN (BAS) control.

minimum_points.name: UNIT CONTROL SOURCE
minimum_points.why: Control source; ISN (BAS) for BMS control

integration.enable: BV 1 REM START STOP CMD (0 = Stop, 1 = Start) is the BAS start/stop and AV 1-2 the remote setpoints. MV 5 shows the control source (Local, ISN (BAS), Analog, Digital, Modem); it should read ISN for BAS control. The points list has no write-enable point.
setup: The BAS connects to the SC-EQ J12 port (RS-485: +, -, COM/REF, SHLD). The card detects BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU or N2 and the baud rate by itself; allow up to 120 seconds after power-up.
The MAC address (1-127) is set on DIP switch SW1 (switch 8 unused). Cycle the card's power after changing it.

The device instance defaults to 5000 + the MAC address (MAC 6 gives 5006). To use another number, set Device Instance Mode to Manual and enter the instance with the SC-AP / MAP tool, or write BV 65000 (mode) and AV 65000 (instance ID).
gotchas: The remote (commandable) setpoints read as unreliable until the BAS writes them the first time.
The SC-EQ only exposes the points that apply to the chiller it detects; if it replaces an E-Link, re-discover the device so old non-applicable points don't sit offline.
Starter type changes what AV 13-15, AV 35 and AV 36 mean; check the starter before trending them.
